thread:
deploy-bot: Starting CI image build + push for `inference-proxy` tag `v3.4.1-canary` (commit abc1234)

aisha: 👍 kicking off canary push to ghcr-eu

deploy-bot: Build succeeded (image size 287MB). Starting registry upload to ghcr-eu.redwood.internal

deploy-bot: upload chunk 1/24 ✅

deploy-bot: upload chunk 2/24 ✅

deploy-bot: upload chunk 3/24 failed — registry responded 502 Bad Gateway

matt: ugh, 502 again from ghcr-eu. Is this the transient proxy?

julien: we've seen packet drops from the eu-ingress LB in the last 10m. ops on it? @ops-bot

ops-bot: Alert created: LB-INGRESS-EU high 5xx rate. Throttling inbound connections for registry cluster while we investigate.

deploy-bot: retrying chunk 3/24 (backoff 3s)

deploy-bot: retry failed — checksum mismatch on chunk 3 (expected 0x8f3a, got 0x7c2b)

aisha: checksum mismatch... could be corrupted upload. Can we re-chunk or push to fallback registry?

matt: fallback registry ghcr-us would avoid eu LB but changes geo. Is that allowed for canary?

release-coordinator: short answer: OK for canary if we pin digest and record routing. Not OK for prod without approval.

julien: ops, can you open a temporary mirror on ghcr-us and let deploy-bot push there?

ops-bot: Creating mirror target ghcr-us.redwood.internal/canary-mirror... should be available in ~60s

deploy-bot: mirror target ready. Switching push target and starting fresh upload.

deploy-bot: pushing to ghcr-us... chunk 1/24 ✅ chunk 2/24 ✅ chunk 3/24 ✅

deploy-bot: pushed manifest and computed digest `sha256:deadbeefcafebabe0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef`

aisha: nice. Let's pin the canary route to that digest and note the original eu push failed.

matt: also add a note in the release notes: canary mirrored to US due to EU registry errors (no prod impact)

deploy-bot: Created release artifact: `inference-proxy@sha256:deadbeefcafebabe0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef` tagged `v3.4.1-canary`

deploy-bot: Canaries started (3 pods) in `canary` namespace. Health checks passing.

julien: rolling forward with canary but postpone prod cutover until we verify LB stability. Set hold for 2 hours.

release-coordinator: agreed. Marking change window note and postponing prod rollout. @aisha please schedule follow-up at 03:00 UTC.

aisha: on it, calendared 03:00 UTC maintenance-check

matt: also adding a pin to our deploy-runbook: if checksum mismatch occurs on chunked uploads -> mirror push to different registry + record digest + abort prod.

deploy-bot: Noted. Thread closed for now. Will post update after 03:00 UTC check.

ops-bot: LB-INGRESS-EU error rate dropped to baseline, but still seeing occasional 502s. Further investigation ongoing.

julien: thanks everyone :thanks:
